bar.book_incremental_value: Report BOOK minus BASE specifically; book promotion requires the bar against BASE and against FIRST
bar.coverage: No reduction in called/eligible coverage relative to control; book-supported observations and FIRST/BASE fallback separately counted
bar.crps: Matched mean CRPS must not increase; adjusted CRPS interval also reported, not misrepresented as proof of equality
bar.safety: No nonfinite or out-of-market-range forecast promoted

uncertainty.bootstrap_seed: Derived from the frozen contract SHA256 and the named comparison; deterministic, never chosen using outcomes
uncertainty.confirmation: Apply the same predeclared tests once on the frozen reserved slice; distinguish insufficient n, failure and passing historical confirmation. Passing does not substitute for fresh LIVE_PAPER confirmation.
contrasts_per_tour_side: each of six BASE_PLUS_SINGLE_BLOCK minus BASE_CORRECTION
uncertainty.multiplicity: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided 95% intervals across 9 contrasts x 2 orientations x 2 tours = 36 comparisons, separately reported for MAE and CRPS. No gate-specific or role-specific promotion claim.
uncertainty.unit: Average paired receipt losses within game/side first; games have equal weight. Resample event dates, then games within dates; keep all of a game's receipts together.
